subject: Upcoming Team Building Event - RSVP Required
body: Dear Team Members, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event on the 25th of April at the local park. This event will be a great opportunity for us to bond and strengthen our teamwork. Please RSVP by the end of this week so we can finalize the arrangements. We encourage everyone to participate and contribute ideas for team building activities. Looking forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
